description: This file contains implementations for consolidating and handling safetensors checkpoint files in a distributed setting. It defines classes for tensor metadata, functions for parsing, writing, reading tensor data using mmap, and orchestrating the consolidation of multiple tensor shards into larger files, including multi-threaded and multi-rank processing.

classes.name: _FqnData
classes.description: Stores information about a tensor given its fully qualified name, including its offset, shape, and data type.

classes.name: _OutputFileData
classes.description: Stores metadata about an output safetensors file, including tensor metadata and size.

classes.name: _InputFileData
classes.description: Stores metadata about an input safetensors file, including its overall metadata and size.

methods.name: None _parse_input_metadata( input_files_data: dict[str, _InputFileData], output_files_data: dict[str, _OutputFileData], )
methods.description: Analyzes input metadata to update output file metadata with tensor shapes and dtypes, considering sharding info.

methods.name: None _write_metadata( output_files_data: dict[str, _OutputFileData], )
methods.description: Writes tensor metadata and offsets into output safetensors files.

methods.name: bytes _read_tensor_data_mmap( file_path: str, start_offset: int, end_offset: int, metadata_size: int, )
methods.description: Reads tensor data from a safetensors file efficiently using mmap.

methods.name: None _process_output_file( output_file: str, output_data: _OutputFileData, input_files_data: dict[str, _InputFileData], )
methods.description: Handles writing tensor data into an output file, combining shards from input files.

methods.name: None _write_data( input_files_data: dict[str, _InputFileData], output_files_data: dict[str, _OutputFileData], num_threads: int = 1, )
methods.description: Coordinates writing tensor data from input files into output files, optionally using multithreading.

methods.name: None _write_sub_tensor_to_file_optimized( full_tensor_mv: memoryview, sub_tensor_bytes: bytes, element_size: int, tensor_shape: list[int], sub_tensor_offsets: list[int], sub_tensor_shape: list[int], )
methods.description: Writes a sub-tensor chunk into the full tensor memory buffer efficiently, handling various sharding patterns.

methods.name: int _calculate_max_contiguous_elements( indices: list[int], sub_tensor_shape: list[int], tensor_shape: list[int], )
methods.description: Calculates the maximum contiguous elements that can be written at a given position, considering tensor layout and sharding.

methods.name: None _write_overall_metadata_file( output_dir: str, output_files_data: dict[str, _OutputFileData], )
methods.description: Creates index.json mapping tensor names to file locations, used for model loading.

methods.name: dict[str,_OutputFileData] _consolidate_safetensors_files( input_dir: str, output_dir: str, fqn_to_file_mapping: dict[str, str], num_threads: int, )
methods.description: Main routine to process all input files, parse metadata, and consolidate shards into output files.

methods.name: None consolidate_safetensors_files( input_dir: str, output_dir: str, fqn_to_index_mapping: dict[str, int], num_threads: int = 1, )
methods.description: High-level function to perform safetensors file consoidation across directory with multiple threads.

methods.name: None consolidate_safetensors_files_on_every_rank( input_dir: str, output_dir: str, fqn_to_index_mapping: dict[str, int], num_threads: int = 1, process_group: dist.ProcessGroup | None = None, )
methods.description: Per-rank distributed consolidation of safetensors files, distributing files based on tensor name indices.
